example.title: Check the controller response through Spring MVC
description: Java `17` and Maven are required. The files form a separate project rooted at `pom.xml`.
This focused application does not include Spring Security. Security-enabled projects need the setup described below.
explanation: Spring creates the controller and injects the `EntryService` mock bean.
`@Autowired` supplies the auto-configured `MockMvc` instance to the test.
The request passes through mapping, path conversion, the controller method, and JSON conversion.
`jsonPath("$.title")` selects the response field being checked.
This checks the controller response. The mocked service does not check persistence or real service decisions.
